summary:
The register has 596 items, traced from the area plot plans (scanned) for Building Area T0008, Process & Utility T0007, LNG Tanks Area T0006 and Jetty Area T0005, plus 12 environment features.

**Site frame.** It comes from general note 2 and the north arrow: plant (0,0) = UTM-39 E 244338.089 N 3179515.690 (EPSG 32639), with plant north 17.9991° clockwise of grid north. I placed the area sheets from battery-limit grid points, with an RMSE of 0.15 m or less. The model's base level is EL 92.5 (ACD 0); grade is HPFS EL 100, and the building area's graded plots are FG EL 97.5.

**Tracing.** Twelve of the 13 packages traced their sheets:
- the 8 LNG tanks with their pumps, jib cranes, elevators, dry chemical packages, roof platforms, overbridges and basins;
- the process and utility units;
- the buildings;
- both jetty heads with their loading arms, dolphins, hooks and monitors;
- the approach trestle;
- the flare.

**Fixes in review and build.**
- The Process & Utility north-east package saved nothing. I traced that region myself: ORVs G~L, trim heaters, BOG compressors and their shelter and crane, the metering shelter and skids, pig launchers, 40-series vessels and heaters, 30-TC-04 and the north N-S rack.
- I removed one wrong item (pipe_rack-pu-conv-01). It was the revetment slope hatching at the top of the P&U sheet, traced as a conveyor rack.

**Heights.** Drawing heights are used where a section states them: Section A-A for the compressor shelter, B-B for the HP pump / vent drum structure, C-C for the process rack, and the 30-V-0001 platform levels. Everything else is indicative or filled from the cloud.

**Environment.**
- The land polygon follows the ortho revetment water edge east of E 440, and the building plan west of it.
- The sea is set at MSL EL 93.56.
- I also added two graded laydown plots and the main roads.
open_questions: Systematic plan offset: 229 items are flagged plan_offset, most of them about 4-8 m north (and in places a few m east) of where the cloud and ortho put them. Is the frame from the drawing note (17.9991°, UTM origin) exactly what the point cloud and ortho were registered to? The ITB originally gave 20.9491° minus 2.95°; the comment sheets mention this.
The cloud check gives plant EL = cloud z + 117.74 m. Please confirm the cloud's vertical datum against HPFS EL 100.000 (= +7.5 m ACD).

22 height_mismatch flags are left as drawn. The 30-V-0002A~N drums show cloud tops of about EL 117 against a drawn 107.6, probably because their supporting structure (TOS 114) is above them. The 30-PR-001/002 and process main racks show cloud tops 2-4 m above the drawn TOS 116.2 / 114.0.

Several tag assignments in the P&U north-east block are inferred, not read from clear leaders: the 40-DCP-001~004 cell order; 40-V-0001 / 40-V-0002 / 40-V-0003 (which drum is which); 40-H-0001; and 50-B-13, which is a 2.4 x 1.9 m box next to the analyzer house 50-AH-0001.
The fuel gas heaters 40-E-0001A~H are modelled as two rows of four with tag null; the letter for each unit was not resolved.
50-A-0001 (metering station package) is in the equipment list but not labelled on the plan. The south skid row in 50-MS-01 is modelled with tag null.
The offsite package (the Unit 98 solids-jetty conveyor trestle and the sea water intake heads, from the overall plan) produced no items. Unit 98 itself is not modelled.

Shoreline west of E 440 comes from the building plan revetment. It lies 12-17 m south of where the ortho's line extrapolates. At the Unit 98 harbour quay the ortho edge is about 20 m beyond the plan revetment.
11 items are flagged missing_in_cloud (e.g. 10-RCM-002, 10-RCM-003, 10-MH-11B02, some tank-east packages and a gate). Are they removed, mislocated, or just poorly scanned?

The cloud shows unregistered features I left unnamed: piping manifolds east of the 40-DCP block (E ~1185, N ~500), small sheds and containers in the building area, and a rotated blue-roof building near E 550 N 450 that the building plan appears not to show.

P4: 70-P-0004A/B: the label leaders end at about E916.5/918.5, N209, just inside the E908 battery-limit corner, and no pump is drawn there. The pumps are placed at the leader ends with low confidence; the drawing that shows them is needed.
P4: 70-A-0014 vs 70-A-0015: neither label has a leader. Pairing them with 70-UB-07 and 70-UB-05 is a guess, and the packages' extents (including the equipment on the slab south of UB-05) are unclear.
P4: Generator and day-tank numbers (G-01..03, V-01..03) are not written on the plan; they are numbered north to south. The horizontal units read as day tanks are an interpretation.
P4: 70-P-0011A/B: which one is A and which is B is taken from the label order.
P4: The large two-hall building east of 70-SS-01 and the north annex have no legible tags. Are they part of the substation, or separate buildings?
P4: Outfall: the narrow double line on the embankment/causeway is read as the sea water outfall channel. Its width, its invert and whether it is open or a culvert are not given.

P3: The ortho photo does not line up with the drawing. 30-V-0001 matches, but the vaporizers, SCVs and 50-TC-10 look about 10-12 m further north in the ortho. Please check the ortho registration; I kept the drawing positions.
P3: Letter order inside each pump row (30-P-0001A~G and H~N, and the matching 30-V-0002 drums) is assumed west to east; the plan gives only range labels.

P3: Process Main PR(E-W): plan column rows are about 7 m apart (N 454.2 and 461.2), but Section C-C gives a 9 m bay. C-C seems to cut the N-S rack at E 1072-1081 instead, so its tiers may not apply to the E-W rack.
P3: Vertical rack text '30-PR-00?' at E ~1098-1104 between 30-PR-001 and 30-PR-002 has its last digit hidden, so I did not model it.
P3: Not modelled: boxes with hatched crosses next to the pump rows (E 1145-1154, N 404-412 and N 424-432) and at E 1101-1110, N 412-424. They may be pump removal or laydown areas.
P3: No drawing elevation for the top of 30-V-0001 or the SCV stacks; pump tops are also indicative.

P6: Which roof pump well each label points to is a guess: A/B/C are the three south-western wells, read on the assumption that the leaders don't cross. A fourth well, marked FUTURE (about E1631.6 N535.7 and E1777.6 N535.7), was not modelled.
P6: The labels for 20-A-0041 and 20-A-0043 are cut off at the east edge of the package. Their positions copy tank 3's layout, 146 m east.

P6: The roof platforms use the tank_lng builder defaults because the drawing gives no deck heights. Should the drawn bearings be used instead? Roughly: safety 355° (85° span), instrument 89°, pump 125° (about 25 × 30 m), flare 228°, unloading 187°.
P6: On the ortho photo the tanks sit about 9 m north of the drawing grid positions. Is the ortho or the frame off?
P6: The fence-like line with posts and two gate symbols along the north road (N about 685) was not modelled. Is it a fence?
P6: The basin depth for 20-TC-06 and all roof elevations are indicative. I assumed the wall top at about EL 141 and the dome crown at EL 151.5.

P5: Central corridor / tank area flare rack (N~440-470): only a row of ~3.5 m squares at N~467 and thin bars at N452-465 are drawn. I could not read them as a rack, so no pipe_rack was added. A larger-scale corridor drawing is needed.

P5: In-tank pump A/B/C assignment comes from the order of the crossing leaders (A = southwest-most column). A 4th FUTURE column at E1339.8 N535.9 (T-0001) and E1485.6 N535.9 (T-0002) was not modelled.
